leads.title: Maldives Penal Code (amended, in force since 16 July 2015)
leads.documents: Primary law criminalizing same-sex sexual activity and same-sex marriage; defines criminal sexual contact, same-sex intercourse as offense, and punishments including imprisonment and supplementary lashes under Sharia.
leads.detail: Cited as section 131, section 411(2) and 411(f), s410(a)(8), s411(a)(2) and 411(d), s412, Section 92(k), section 1205; no URL visible in text

leads.title: International Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans, and Intersex Association (ILGA)
leads.documents: Documents that pre-amendment Penal Code left sexual conduct un-codified to Islamic law for Muslims only, and that amended 2015 Code tightened LGBTQ-related laws.
leads.detail: Cited in article as authority on Penal Code history; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Bureau of Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor (2020). 2020 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Maldives - Section 6. Discrimination and Societal Abuses
leads.documents: U.S. government human-rights report documenting societal stigma against LGBTI persons in Maldives, lack of official complicity reports, and online harassment of pro-LGBTI voices as 'apostates'.
leads.detail: United States Department of State Report; citation visible in Further reading: Bureau of Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor (2020). Section 6. Discrimination and Societal Abuses

leads.title: Human Rights Commission of the Maldives (HRCM) submission to Universal Periodic Review, September 2014
leads.documents: National human-rights institution submission showing no LGBTQ rights issues discussed; highlights freedom of expression, threats to activists, and mandate limited to rights 'in accordance with Islamic Sharia and the Constitution'.
leads.detail: Cited as HRCM submission to UPR September 2014 with reference to Human Rights Commission Act objectives; no URL visible

leads.title: United Nations Human Rights Council report on its thirtieth session (2016) - UPR outcome for Maldives
leads.documents: Documents Maldives accepted 198 of 258 UPR recommendations and rejected 60 that contradicted Islamic faith/Constitution, including those relating to lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and non-traditional family.
leads.detail: Cited as United Nations' 2016 report of the Human Rights Council on its thirtieth session; no URL visible

leads.title: International Service for Human Rights (ISHR) briefing paper to Maldives second cycle UPR, May 2015
leads.documents: Documents that un-codified Muslim Sharia Law criminalizes homosexual conduct, making Maldives insecure for LGBTQ advocacy.
leads.detail: Cited as May 2015 briefing paper submitted to Maldives' second cycle Universal Periodic Review; quote visible but no URL

leads.title: Human Rights Council National Report for the Maldives, 2015
leads.documents: Government national report showing post-2010 democratic transition developments but no detailing of LGBTQ human rights issues or developments.
leads.detail: Cited as Human Rights Council's National Report for the Maldives in 2015; no URL visible

leads.title: United Nations SOGI resolutions record: 2008 GA decriminalization statement, 2011 South Africa resolution, September 2014 HRC resolution
leads.documents: Documents Maldives as initial signer of 57-member opposing document (read by Syrian representative) in 2008 and rejection of 2011 and 2014 resolutions affirming LGBTQ rights / sexual orientation and gender identity.
leads.detail: Cited as 2008 European-drafted statement, Syrian-read opposing document, June 2011 Republic of South Africa resolution, September 2014 HRC SOGI resolution; no URL visible

leads.title: 2014 New Zealand asylum case of Abraham Naim / New Zealand Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment decision
leads.documents: Documented incident of gay Maldivian granted refugee status as at risk of serious harm from state agents if returned; includes President's Office spokesman Ibrahim Muaz comment that asylum seekers on sexual orientation grounds would face prosecution on return.
leads.detail: Cited as 2014 article in New Zealand, MBIE grant of refugee status, Ibrahim Muaz spokesman comment; outlet name and URL not visible in text

leads.title: UN Human Rights Council / UNFPA recommendations 2015 and Action Canada for Population and Development response
leads.documents: Documents institutional calls to enact anti-discrimination law including sexual orientation, combat stigmatization, protect those perceived as homosexual or transgender from hate crimes, and decriminalize consenting same-sex relations - noted but not accepted by Maldives.
leads.detail: Cited as 2015 Human Rights Council recommendation, UNFPA recommendation on law reform/protection, Action Canada concern over rejection; no URL visible
